questions.q_en: Which of the following is the only riverine port among the 12 major ports of India?
questions.solution_en:
• Kolkata Port, officially known as Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, is the only riverine port among India's 12 major ports. It is situated on the banks of the Hooghly River and has a twin dock system - Haldia dock and Kolkata dock.

• Paradip Port: Located in Odisha, it is at the confluence of the Mahanadi River and the Bay of Bengal but is not riverine.

• Visakhapatnam Port : A natural harbor but not riverine.

• Kamarajar Port : A corporate port near Chennai, not riverine.

questions.q_en: Which of the following ports is known as the busiest container port in India?

• Mumbai Port : One of the busiest ports but mainly deals with crude oil and bulk cargo.

• Chennai Port : The second-largest container port but not the busiest.

• Cochin Port : Handles transshipment but not the largest container hub.

• Paradip Port : Important for iron ore export but not landlocked.

• Tuticorin Port : An artificial port but not landlocked.

• Kamarajar Port : A corporate port near Chennai, but not landlocked.
